- Client updates
  - The readiness matrix has been updated. Would appreciate a review / update from each client (erigon, ethereumjs, geth, Nethermind). [Tweet](https://twitter.com/teamipsilon/status/1787524868411371644)
- Compiler updates
- Spec updates
  - make a final call on address space expansion in [EIP-7069](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7069) (EXT*CALLs)
  - the final call on removing TXCREATE/InitcodeTx https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/76
  - https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/86
- Testing updates
- Other items
  - review the update to the https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/issues/94#issuecomment-2083078483 and related EIP rationale update: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8506.
  - discuss RETURNDATA* 0-padding (https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/90)
  - Tune `EXTCALL` with value cost: https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/issues/94.
  - Increase the call's `MIN_RETAINED_GAS`: https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/issues/95.

Please add other agenda items or links to discuss.
